what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as manager.audit. Looked in Money (Sales & receipts, Receipts & retainers, Budgets and costs, Ledger & setup), Projects, Settings, the Ask assistant and global search. Found a 'Customer statement' on Receipts & retainers, but it only lists clients (Kapoor Family, Mehta Traders, Rao Family), not vendors. Global search found vendor 'Shree Tiles Pvt Ltd', but its Quick look card only has an 'Open' button, which left me on the same Ledger page with no vendor view. Ledger 'Pay a supplier' said 'This company has no supplier balances to pay.' Asking the assistant for a statement of account got 'I could not turn that into a report.' I never found a vendor statement of account, so nothing was produced or downloaded.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: Money > Budgets and costs (project budgets and cost register, no vendor info)
Money > Ledger & setup > Trace general ledger (account ledger, not vendor statement)
Ledger > Pay a supplier (no supplier balances)
Ask assistant (could not produce a report)
unnecessary_steps: Search result -> Quick look -> Open was a two-step detour that led nowhere
Page scroll position persisted between tab changes so a tab click once missed
Assistant asked 'A question or something to record?' before failing
confusing_terminology: Ledger & setup -> page is titled 'Protected INR ledger' / 'Accounting Ledger', three names for one place
Verify GL / AP integrity, Trace general ledger -> jargon for a new user
Customer statement -> exists only for clients, so a vendor statement is not implied
Pay staff reimbursements shown first on the vendor/ledger page, unrelated
missing_feedback: Quick look 'Open' button on the vendor gave no visible change
Assistant failure message suggests an unrelated example query ('how many open issues by owner')
Inbox count rose from 9 to 10 during the session without explanation (a draft 'Bulk supplier bill payment' appeared)
unexpected_behaviour: Vendor 'Shree Tiles Pvt Ltd' exists in search but has no reachable page
Open on a contact stays on the current page
errors_encountered: I could not turn that into a report. Try "how many open issues by owner".
This company has no supplier balances to pay.
visual_issues: Ledger action buttons are a dense wall of similar outline buttons
Selected sub-tab and primary buttons look alike, hard to tell what is a tab versus an action
Dropdown list in Customer statement renders with default browser styling
accessibility_issues: Could not verify keyboard use; I used only mouse clicks
Small grey helper text with low contrast
observations: Customer statements exist but vendor statements do not appear to. There is no Contacts or Vendors area in the main navigation, so a vendor can only be reached through search, and the vendor card is a dead end. Statement of account for a vendor is not discoverable for a new manager.

rating_justifications.feature_discoverability: After about 59 actions I never found a vendor statement; only a client-only Customer statement exists.
rating_justifications.ease_of_use: Dead ends: vendor Open button did nothing visible, assistant could not produce a report.
rating_justifications.clarity_of_terminology: Ledger area is named three ways and uses jargon such as GL / AP integrity.
rating_justifications.workflow_efficiency: Many wasted steps across Money tabs, Settings, Projects and the assistant with no result.
rating_justifications.navigation_clarity: No Vendors or Contacts section in the sidebar; the vendor was reachable only via search and led nowhere.
rating_justifications.system_feedback: Open on the vendor gave no feedback; assistant error offered an irrelevant suggestion.
rating_justifications.error_recovery: The assistant error gave no useful route forward and the vendor Open button gave no message at all.
rating_justifications.overall_user_experience: The objective could not be completed.
